sessions.phase_label: Initial landing-page layout, media, and content revisions
Pricing guidance and specification of remaining page variants and edits
Migration, implementation review, and responsive fixes

requirements.title: Natural Hero Block Layout
requirements.definition: Format the top hero block as a visually complete, natural-looking section whose media does not intrude into the text area.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the hero block's overall layout and text/media separation; replacing its image with a playable video is a separate media behavior.

requirements.title: Playable Hero Video
requirements.definition: Replace the hero image with the client-supplied video and ensure that the video plays in the page preview.
requirements.boundary_note: Video selection and playback are tightly coupled acceptance criteria for one media integration; the surrounding hero layout remains separate.

requirements.title: Direct Mobile YouTube Icon Visibility
requirements.definition: Display the YouTube icon directly in the upper-right area on mobile without requiring the user to open a dropdown.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile direct visibility can fail and be fixed independently of whether the underlying YouTube navigation link exists on desktop.

requirements.title: Pricing Color Editing Instructions
requirements.definition: Provide accessible written instructions identifying the code locations used to change pricing-panel outline and button colors.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested instructional artifact remains independently required even if no pricing colors are changed during the task.

requirements.title: Deliver Pages in Migrated Kajabi Account
requirements.definition: Ensure the revised primary and duplicate pages are present in the client's new Kajabi account, transferring work from the old account when necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: Correct-account delivery is independently required even if every page behavior works in the obsolete account; it is not generic administration.

requirements.title: Secondary Course-Content Navigation Controls
requirements.definition: Place a secondary 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇 control directly beneath each applicable primary button, without the primary button wrapper styling, and make it link to the course-content section.
requirements.boundary_note: Presence under each primary control, close spacing, secondary styling, and linkability are coupled acceptance criteria for one repeated navigation mechanism.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Panel Frame Fit
requirements.definition: Keep the pricing panels fully within the mobile viewport without extending outside the page frame.

unresolved_candidates.description: The conversation does not fully resolve which late revisions apply to both page variants versus only the priced or duplicate page; the client rejects the freelancer's inference that all comments apply to both and asks that both pages be checked.
